notes.title: Thank You, Roadmap, Update
notes.content:
Hi Guys

I want to say thanks to everyone who has checked out the game. I'm thrilled to announce that we've sold more than 250 copies this week! I would also like to outline the upcoming content for the end Nov and share some of my thoughts.

Patreon & Steam Update:
Typically, each update provides an additional 1hr to 45 minutes of gameplay. I usually complete my work by the end of the month and release it on Patreon, but sometimes I find myself spending an additional week or two fixing bugs and polishing animations. So, I might release updates on Steam in the middle of the month at times.

Next Steam Update, ETA End Nov ~ Mid-December:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886329/da509e58c9f9f5756ce304fefcc19f7a0333fde9.png
